shadows.label: 阴影 2 - Shadow 2
shadows.description: Dragging: scale 1.03, shadow `rgba(9,30,66,0.25) 0 12px 24px`, slight rotation optional; a placeholder gap (`#091E4224` dashed/filled) opens in the list

shadows.label: 阴影 3 - Shadow 3
shadows.description: Shadow Philosophy: Shadows use Trello's signature navy tint (`rgba(9,30,66,…)`) rather than pure black, so they read correctly on both pale lists and colored backdrops. Elevation is meaningful: a card at rest has a whisper-thin shadow; the moment you pick it up the shadow jumps dramatically — depth communicates "this is now in your hand". Lists have just enough shadow to lift off the backdrop.

borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Divider (`#DFE1E6`): Hairline rules between card sections and within sheets.

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: Border Strong (`#C1C7D0`): Input outline at rest, checklist separators.

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: The accent system is restrained against a backdrop that may be loud. Trello Blue for actions sits at `#0C66E4` (the modern Atlassian-era blue, distinct from the classic board blue `#0079BF`), used for the primary button, links, and the active state. Card label colors (a fixed palette of green/yellow/orange/red/purple/blue swatches) are the one place color runs free — they're functional tags, not decoration. Everything else is neutral ink (`#172B4D`) on white cards so cards stay readable regardless of how vivid the board behind them is.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心
panels.body: 适合在 390×844 画布中预览的移动产品体验。

panels.title: 颜色与字体可复用
panels.body: 页面从本地 metadata 与 Design.md 提取 palette、typography 和标签，用于快速预览主题质感。

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Let the board background (solid {#0079BF}, gradient, or photo) define the screen — there is no fixed canvas。
建议：Float pale lists ({#F1F2F4}) of white cards on the backdrop。
建议：Use Trello Blue {#0C66E4} for actions/links; reserve the classic {#0079BF} for the default board color。
建议：Keep navy ink ({#172B4D}) on white cards so they read over any backdrop。
建议：Use the fixed six-color label palette as functional tags — the one place color is free。
dont: 避免：impose a single canvas color — the board backdrop owns the screen。
避免：add a bottom tab bar — Trello navigates via the top bar and the horizontal board。
避免：tint card text with label colors — labels are bars/chips; titles stay navy ink。
避免：use pure black shadows — use the navy {rgba(9,30,66,…)} tint so they work on color and pale surfaces。
避免：make the drag lift subtle — picking up a card must feel like lifting a physical card。
